messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=redwood-inference-prod, severity=critical — sustained 5xx spike on /v1/generate (us-west-2). Error rate 42% over 2m. PD: <https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-7821|PD-7821>
ali: acking and taking lead. pulling logs now.
deploy-bot: Deploy record: v2026.03.12-rc3 rolled to canaries in us-west-2 at 03:09 UTC (kernel runtime r2, quant path enabled).
michelle: seeing consistent NPE in model-loader when unmarshalling kv-cache blob, stack: model-loader->kvstore->deserialize. small percentage of requests hit it but amplifies due to retry loop.
samuel: customer impact: CS reported 2 enterprise customers seeing session failures and chat timeouts. ~12% of overall requests returned 503/504.
ali: initial mitigation plan: 1) stop further canary promotion 2) rollback canaries to previous release v2026.03.12-rc2 3) route traffic off us-west-2 canaries if rollback slow.
ali: rollback command I'm going to run:
```
# roll back rollout to previous stable revision
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime --to-revision=42
```
alarm-bot: NOTE: PagerDuty escalation will trigger in 5 minutes if not resolved or ack escalated.
ali: acked PD incident and added context. tagging @jordan for L2 escalation if rollback fails.
jordan: on it. I'll warm fallback model variant and prepare traffic diversion.
michelle: starting rollback now. patching deployment: setting image: redwood/inference-runtime:v2026.03.12-rc2
deploy-bot: rollback initiated: 8/40 pods updated -> 18/40 -> 32/40. streaming events...
michelle: observed telemetry: p95 latency briefly up while pods drain, but error rate is dropping from 42% -> 15% within 90s.
samuel: notifying CS + account owners with short impact note and ETA for recovery. pinging legal for any potential SLA noise.
ali: diverting canary traffic off the affected variant as an extra precaution:
```
# divert traffic to stable variant
redwood route set --service inference --region us-west-2 --variant v2026.03.12-rc2 --weight 100
```
jordan: diversion complete. fallback model warmed in 3 instances, healthchecks green.
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: incident acknowledged by ali; escalation suppressed.
michelle: rollback complete: all pods on v2026.03.12-rc2. error rate now 1.8% in us-west-2 (within normal). marking incident for monitoring window.
ali: verifying logs for any remaining error buckets. will capture failing request ids and provide to michelle for a focused repro.
samuel: CS message sent: "We've mitigated the issue by rolling back the canary. We're collecting logs and will follow up with RCA." :white_check_mark:
jordan: handing off follow-up to morning oncall (04:00 UTC) for postmortem + test coverage action items. ali will own short-term runbook items until handoff.
ali: handing off to @jordan at 04:00 UTC — will update thread with failing req ids and a short blameless timeline.
jordan: acknowledged handoff. will open an incident ticket and link to this thread.
michelle: immediate action items: add binary-parsing regression tests, add kv-cache defensive checks, and add canary guard to block runtime kernel+quant path changes without integration tests.
ali: agreed. creating a quick TODO list and tagging related owners.
incident-bot: auto-note: incident closed for paging purposes; monitoring window active for 30m. If error rate rises above threshold, PagerDuty will re-trigger.
ali: thanks everyone. logging this as a 'deploy-triggered regression' and will create postmortem draft later today.
